events.text: Rosa: Sure thing, Bo — I can help organize the repair drive and keep things moving. Tell me what needs fixing first, and I’ll start from there.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Bo: Great — let’s start with the broken fence panels and the leaky mailbox. I’ll keep it simple and just point out the biggest stuff.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll put the fence panels and mailbox at the top of the list, and we can tackle the rest after that. If you notice anything else big, just let me know.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Bo: Sounds good — fence panels and the leaky mailbox first. If anything else big comes up, I’ll point it out.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Gus: Got it — I’ll bring my hammer, screwdriver set, tape measure, and a couple wrenches. If anything else turns up, just let me know and I’ll add it.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Bo: Perfect — that should cover the big stuff. I’ll let you know if I spot anything else worth fixing.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo — I may be a bit late, but I’ll still come by and help where I can.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Bo: No worries, Dane — just swing by when you can. We’re starting with the fence panels and the mailbox, so that’ll be plenty.

events.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll head over as soon as I can and jump in on the fence panels or mailbox.

events.text: Tess: I’m keeping an ear out, Bo — last I heard folks were still dropping off tools, so I’ll let you know if hammers, screwdrivers, or extension cords are still needed.

events.text: Bo: Perfect — just keep me posted if anything big changes. I’m still focused on the broken fence panels and the leaky mailbox.

events.text: Tess: Will do, Bo — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if the repair list changes, especially for those fence panels or the mailbox.

events.text: Hana: I’m still checking the repair-drive details, so I don’t want to guess. I’ll send the confirmed list as soon as I’ve verified it.

events.text: Bo: No worries — just send the confirmed list when you’ve got it, and I’ll focus on the biggest fixes first.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — I’ll confirm the list and send it over as soon as it’s ready.

events.text: Bo: Great — keep me posted on the big fixes, and I’ll stay focused on the urgent stuff first.

events.text: Faye: Of course — send me the latest pickup and drop-off windows, and I’ll work around them so the repair drive stays smooth.

events.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring the extension cord plus screws, nails, and cleaning supplies. See you at the repair drive.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Bo: Great, that should cover it — see you there, and I’ll keep an eye out for the biggest fixes first.

events.text: Sam: Perfect — I’ll start with the biggest fixes and have everything ready when I get there.

events.text: Bo: Perfect — just focus on the big missing stuff first, and I’ll keep an eye out for anything urgent.

events.text: Bo: Perfect — that should cover the big stuff. I’ll let you know if I spot anything else worth fixing.
